Nora (Finance): Heads-up: automated billing run `batch_20260323_02` finished but Support flagged several customers with 'invoice total mismatch' — some invoices were duplicated and some had missing reserved credits lines.

Diego (Billing Eng): Which batch id and sample invoice? Ill check the gen logs and DB audit.

Nora (Finance): batch_20260323_02. Sample acct: BetaCorp (acct_id=66321). System created INV-66321-20260323-1 (total €4,120.00) and INV-66321-20260323-2 (total €1,890.00). The second invoice is missing the reserved capacity credit lines and shows only subscription/seat charges.

Sasha (RevOps): I pulled the billing preview for acct 66321; reserved credit rows exist in the usage table but somehow didn't make it into INV-66321-20260323-2. Also noticed a currency_rounding tag on the job: convert_to_eur=true. Could be a rounding filter applied after line aggregation.

BillingBot: [system] invoice_generator v2.15 job job_20260323_02_4 WARNING duplicate_invoice_detected for acct=66321; created provisional invoice INV-66321-20260323-2 (status: issued). Reason: shard_split_missing_lines.

Diego (Billing Eng): Checking logs. We recently changed the reserved-credit normalization to store credits as negative usage rows and theres a join on usage_batch_id. If the batch was sharded mid-normalization the negative rows might have landed in a different shard. That would cause one invoice to have only positives and the other to have the negatives.

Priya (Acct Mgr): Customer already contacted support. Theyre worried about being charged twice. We need to consolidate and issue a credit memo if necessary. Does Finance need to approve voiding the duplicate?

Nora (Finance): Yes, need approval to void the incorrect invoice and issue a credit memo + reissue a consolidated invoice. Estimate net effect: zero after credit, but customer showback will look cleaner. Approve?

Sasha (RevOps): +1 approve. Also recommend we temporarily disable auto-issue when shard_split_missing_lines is present. We should also run a scan across the batch for similarly affected accts.

Diego (Billing Eng): Plan: 1) run quick scanner to list accounts with shard_split_missing_lines for batch_20260323_02, 2) run consolidation tool to recombine usage rows per acct and regenerate invoice payloads, 3) create credit memos for erroneous issued invoices and mark them void, 4) emit reissued invoices with note "reissued due to billing shard split". Dry-run first.

Diego (Billing Eng): Commands: 
```
billing_scan --batch batch_20260323_02 --filter shard_split_missing_lines --output affected_list.csv
billing_regen --batch batch_20260323_02 --recombine --dry-run --acct-list affected_list.csv
billing_recon --apply --acct 66321 --void-invoice INV-66321-20260323-2 --create-credit CM-66321-20260323 --reissue INV-66321-20260323-re1
```

BillingBot: [system] ticket created: BIL-8980 (investigate shard_split_missing_lines + auto-issue guard).

Nora (Finance): Approve the void + reissue for BetaCorp. Please include a customer note and attach a reconciliation CSV to this thread.

Priya (Acct Mgr): Will prepare the customer note template. Suggest: short apology, explanation that a duplicate was generated due to internal billing normalization, confirmation of net impact 0, and the new invoice number.

Diego (Billing Eng): Running scan now. Quick result: 5 accounts affected in this batch (66321, 77102, 77211, 78009, 78433). Dry-run regen looks clean for all 5; reserved credit rows are recombined.

Diego (Billing Eng): Applying fixes for acct 66321 after approvals. Created credit memo CM-66321-20260323 and reissued invoice INV-66321-20260323-re1. Marked INV-66321-20260323-2 as void. Posting reconciliation: attached summary (reconciled_rows=186, net_change=0).

Nora (Finance): Thanks. Please attach the full affected_list.csv and runbook notes. Also add a rollback plan in case reissue causes downstream payment processing issues.

Sasha (RevOps): Adding postmortem to BIL-8980: root cause = shard timing + negative-credit normalization; remediation = hold-on-shard_split_missing_lines, prefer atomic normalization, add unit test for negative row sharding.

Priya (Acct Mgr): Customer notified and thanked us for the quick fix. Will follow up if they have questions.

Diego (Billing Eng): Filed PR to gate auto-issue on shard_split_missing_lines and added metric for negative-row drift. Will drop the reconciliation CSV here in ~10m.

BillingBot: [system] reconciliation_report uploaded: s3://redwood-billing/reports/2026-03-23/batch_20260323_02_recon_1870129999.csv

Nora (Finance): Great work. Let's ensure BIL-8980 includes timeline and estimates for a full fix. Closing loop here once postmortem is in.
